title: Card Network Charge Intent for HTTP Payment Authentication (draft-card-charge-00)
quote: Only encrypted network tokens travel in the credential. The client never has access to decrypted token material. ... The key MUST be RSA with a minimum length of 2048 bits [alg RSA-OAEP-256]. ... Clients and servers MUST NOT parse the encryptedPayload field. ... Each credential MUST be usable only once per challenge. Servers MUST use challenge.id as an idempotency key when forwarding. ... Servers SHOULD return 200 immediately after authorization approval, even though final fund settlement is pending. ... All MPP exchanges MUST occur over TLS 1.2 or higher. [Author: J. Brans (Visa); Informational; 3 June 2026, expires 5 December 2026.]

title: Card — MPP (Machine Payments Protocol)
quote: The Card method enables payments using encrypted, single use network payment tokens and dynamic data provided by a card network for machine-initiated transactions. Payment tokens, such as those provided by Visa Intelligent Commerce, settle through existing card infrastructure, and the client and server can each use independent payment providers rather than sharing a single platform.

title: EMV Secure Remote Commerce
quote: EMV SRC accommodates options for using dynamic data, such as cryptograms or other transaction-unique data, to enhance the security of payment transactions. EMV Payment Tokenisation replaces the sensitive Primary Account Number (PAN) with a non-sensitive surrogate value called an EMV Payment Token.

title: Trusted Agent Protocol — Visa Developer
quote: Visa's Trusted Agent Protocol (TAP) cryptographically verifies that an AI agent is legitimate and truly acting on a user's behalf, using cryptographically signed HTTP messages to transmit an agent's intent, verified user identity, and payment details.

title: Visa Introduces Trusted Agent Protocol: An Ecosystem-Led Framework for AI Commerce
quote: In October 2025, Visa and more than 10 partners introduced Trusted Agent Protocol, an open framework designed on existing web infrastructure that enables safe agent-driven checkout. Visa Intelligent Commerce Connect enables merchants to accept payments initiated via major agent protocols including Trusted Agent Protocol, Machine Payments Protocol (MPP), and Agentic Commerce Protocol.

title: Industry Perspectives on the Evolution of EMV Payment Tokenization
quote: EMV Payment Tokenization provides a technology solution for protecting the PAN and securing digital and online payments; each token is bound to a specific merchant and each transaction is protected with a one-time-use cryptogram. Payment Account Reference (PAR) was introduced in EMV Specification Bulletin No. 167.

title: What Is MPP? The Machine Payments Protocol by Tempo Explained
quote: MPP supports multiple payment methods beyond blockchain — including cards (via Stripe), Bitcoin Lightning, and stablecoins — and a server can advertise multiple methods, with the client picking whichever it supports.

title: Deep Dive: The Machine Payments Protocol
quote: MPP defines how agents discover prices, request payment, authorize charges, manage subscriptions, and reconcile, separating the core authentication scheme from per-method specifications such as card, stablecoin, and Lightning.
